explication: This repository is a human-curated “awesome” resource directory, not an executable application. A reader starts at the README contents, chooses a subject area, and follows curated links to external projects and references. The README also points contributors to the contribution guide, list-creation guide, and explanation of what an awesome list is. The available README excerpt shows the broad category index and part of the catalog; the graph therefore summarizes the catalog rather than claiming to map every entry.
